harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: «ما» is a relative noun, the fāʿil (agent); the clause «وهو العزيز» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause from the Divine Name.

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: The clause «هو الذي» is resumptive; the preposition and its genitive noun «من أهل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «كفروا»; the preposition and its genitive noun «من ديارهم» is attached to «أخرج»; it is permissible for two identical particles to be attached to one governing word because their meanings differ: the first is for clarifying the genus and the second for the beginning of the extent. The preposition and its genitive noun «لأول» is attached to «أخرج», and it is the lām of timing, i.e.: at the first gathering; the clause «ما ظننتم» is resumptive, and أنَّ with what follows it stands in place of the two objects of «ظن»; the clause «وظنوا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «ما ظننتم»; «حصونهم» is the fāʿil (agent) of «مانعتهم». The preposition and its genitive noun «من الله» is attached to «مانعتهم»; the clause «فأتاهم» is conjoined to the clause «ظنوا». «حيث» is an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of a genitive, attached to «أتاهم»; the clause «لم يحتسبوا» is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause «يخربون» is resumptive, and the clause «فاعتبروا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; «أَنْ» with what follows it is to be interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "موجود" (existing); the preposition and its genitive noun «في الآخرة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «عذاب»; the clause «ولهم عذاب» is resumptive and is not conjoined to the apodosis clause, because if you conjoined it, it would entail that punishment is withheld from them in the Hereafter, whereas the punishment in this world is withheld because of the occurrence of the exile.

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: (ذلك بأنهم شاقوا الله) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) made of «أنَّ» and what follows it is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); the conditional clause is resumptive; «من» is a conditional noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause «يشاق» is the khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: «ما» is a conditional noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition and its genitive noun «من لينة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «ما»; «قائمة» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ. The preposition and its genitive noun «على أصولها» is attached to «قائمة»; the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa); the preposition and its genitive noun «بإذن» is attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: so their cutting was by Allah's permission (فَقَطْعُها بإذن الله); the genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) «وليخزي» is attached to an implied (muqaddar) verb, i.e.: and He permitted their cutting in order to disgrace; the implied clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «ما قطعتم».

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: The clause «وما أفاء» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {مَا قَطَعْتُمْ}; «ما» is a conditional noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition and its genitive noun «منهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أفاء»; the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa); «ما» is negative; «خيل» is the mafʿūl bihi of «أوجف», and «من» is redundant (zāʾida); the clause «ولكن الله ...» is conjoined to the clause «ما أفاء الله»; the clause «والله قدير» is resumptive; the preposition and its genitive noun «على كل» is attached to «قدير».

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: «ما» is conditional, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition and its genitive noun «من أهل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أفاء»; the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa); the preposition and its genitive noun «لله» is attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: then it is for Allah (فهو لله); «كي» is an infinitival and subjunctive-governing particle, and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is accusative by removal of the preposition, the lām; the adverb «بين» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «دولة»; the preposition and its genitive noun «منكم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الأغنياء». The clause «وما آتاكم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «ما أفاء الله»; «ما» in his words «ما آتاكم» is conditional, mafʿūl bihi; the clause «وما نهاكم» is conjoined to the clause «آتاكم الله»; «ما» in «وما نهاكم» is a mubtadaʾ and not an object, because the verb «نهاكم» has taken its full object.

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «للفقراء» is a badal (substitute) from his words {وَلِذِي الْقُرْبَى} and what follows it; what prevented substitution from «لله وللرسول» is that it is obligatory to magnify them both; the clause «يبتغون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «أخرجوا»; the preposition and its genitive noun «من الله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (verbal noun) «فضلا»; «هم» is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl).

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The wāw is resumptive; «الذين» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is «يحبون», and the clause is resumptive. His words «والإيمان»: a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «الدار»; the verb is made to include the meaning of «لزموا» (they adhered to), so that conjoining «الإيمان» to it is sound, since faith is not something one settles in; the preposition and its genitive noun «من قبلهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause «يحبون» is the khabar of «الذين»; the preposition and its genitive noun «في صدورهم» is attached to the second object of «وجد»; the preposition and its genitive noun «مما» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «حاجة»; the wāw in «ولو» is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and the clause «لو كان» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause; this wāw conjoins to an implied (muqaddar) ḥāl for exhaustiveness, i.e.: they prefer [others] in every state, even in this state. The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, what precedes indicating it; the clause «ومَنْ يوق» is parenthetical; «مَنْ» is conditional, a mubtadaʾ, and the clause «يوق» is the khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: The clause «والذين جاءوا..» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «الذين تبوءوا ...»; the clause «ولا تجعل» is conjoined to the clause «اغفر»; the preposition and its genitive noun «في قلوبنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object; «للذين» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «غِلا»; the clause «ربنا» is a resumption within the scope of the saying; and the clause «إنك رءوف», the answer to the vocative, is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: The clause «يقولون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الذين»; the preposition and its genitive noun «من أهل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl from the wāw in «كفروا»; the clause «لئن أُخرجتم» is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); «أبدًا» is an adverb of time attached to «نطيع»; the clause «لننصرنَّكم» is the answer to the oath, and before «إنْ» there is an implied (muqaddar) lām; the clause «إنهم لكاذبون» is the answer to the oath, on the basis that «يشهد» is made to include the meaning of an oath; the hamza of «إنَّ» takes kasra because of the lām in its khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The clause «لا يخرجون» is the answer to the oath, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, the answer to the oath indicating it. His words «ليُوَلُّن»: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, which was omitted because of a succession of identical letters; the wāw, omitted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the fāʿil (agent); «الأدبار» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause «لا ينصرون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «ليولن».

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: (لأنتم أشد رهبة) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The lām is of inception (ibtidāʾ); «رهبة» is tamyīz (specification); the preposition and its genitive noun «في صدورهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «رهبة»; the preposition and its genitive noun «من الله» is attached to «أشدّ»; the genitive interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is attached to the khabar (predicate); and the clause «لا يفقهون» is a naʿt of «قوم».

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: The clause «لا يقاتلونكم» is resumptive; «جميعا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «يقاتلون»; «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); the preposition and its genitive noun «في قرى» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the preposition and its genitive noun «من وراء» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preposition and its genitive noun «في قرى», attached to what it is attached to; the clause «بأسهم شديد» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «تحسبهم»; and the clause «وقلوبهم شتى» is a ḥāl clause from the hāʾ in «تحسبهم».

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «كمثل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: their likeness is as the likeness (مثلهم كمثل); «قريبا» is an adverb of time attached to «ذاقوا»; and the clause «ولهم عذاب» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «ذاقوا».

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: «كمثل» is parsed like its counterpart in the previous verse; «إذ» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the [notion of] being-settled (al-istiqrār) to which the khabar (predicate) is attached; the conditional clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «قال»; the preposition and its genitive noun «منك» is attached to «بريء»; the clause «إني أخاف» is resumptive within the scope of the saying.

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The clause «فكان» is resumptive; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is the noun of kāna; «خالدين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in the omitted khabar (predicate); and the clause «وذلك جزاء» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: «الذين» is ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition); the clause «ولتنظر» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «اتقوا»; «ما» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The clause «ولا تكونوا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding clause {اتَّقُوا}; the clause «فأنساهم» is conjoined to the clause «نسوا»; «هم» is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl).

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: The clause «أصحاب الجنة ...» is resumptive; «هم» is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl).

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: «خاشعا متصدعا» are two ḥāls (circumstantials) from the hāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun «من خشية» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «متصدِّعا»; the clause «نضربها» is the khabar (predicate); and the clause «لعلهم يتفكرون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: «الذي» is a naʿt (adjective) of the Divine Name; «عالم» is a naʿt of the Divine Name; the clause «هو الرحمن» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: «الذي» is a naʿt (adjective) of the Divine Name; the clause of transcendence [«لا إله إلا هو»] is the ṣila (relative clause); «هو» is a badal (substitute) from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in the omitted khabar (predicate); «الملك» and what follows it are attributes of the Divine Name; the preposition and its genitive noun «عمَّا» is composed of the preposition «عن» and the maṣdariyya (infinitival) «ما», and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (muqaddar) governor that puts «سبحان» in the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: His words «هو الله»: a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and what follows it are naʿts (adjectives) of the Divine Name; the clause «له الأسماء» is a second khabar of the Divine Name; the clause «يسبح» is resumptive; the clause «وهو العزيز» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause, and «الحكيم» is a second khabar.
